content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Understanding the significance of Bitcoin payments for digital downloads requires a grasp of the current landscape. Traditional platforms often charge exorbitant fees, like Gumroad’s 10% per sale, which can eat into your profits significantly. By utilizing Bitcoin and services like NOWPayments, which only charges a 0.5% fee, you can retain more of your earnings. This shift not only allows for greater financial freedom but also offers a pathway to sovereignty over your digital commerce endeavors, ensuring that you are not locked out of the global market due to platform limitations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of selling digital products with Bitcoin lies in a modular infrastructure. By deploying a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing, you create a streamlined experience for yourself and your customers. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, and the product is delivered automatically via a simple script. This setup minimizes reliance on intermediaries, ensuring that you maintain full ownership of your data and product delivery mechanisms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment options are either non-existent or heavily restricted. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets like fonts and presets, this solution empowers you by providing a seamless way to accept Bitcoin payments. The architecture is designed for those who value sovereignty over their financial transactions, allowing you to operate independently of traditional payment processors, thus enhancing your business's resilience against external pressures.
Keep more of your earnings with lower transaction fees—0.5% vs. 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful execution of Bitcoin payments for digital downloads relies on several key components. Utilizing free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages allows you to present your products without incurring high costs. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers facilitates the backend logic for processing orders and automating product delivery. When combined with NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a mere 0.5% fee, this architecture not only enhances the user experience but also maximizes your profit margins by minimizing transaction costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, begin by setting up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you can accept Bitcoin and other currencies. By following these steps, you can establish a fully operational digital commerce stack that not only facilitates sales but also protects your interests as a creator. For a comprehensive guide, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which includes all the blueprints and templates you need.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage a Bitcoin payment system using services like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept crypto payments directly, ensuring low transaction fees and instant delivery of your products. By using a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you maintain full control over your sales.
Enjoy full ownership of your digital products and infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your own digital store with cryptocurrency payments. This approach allows for complete ownership and autonomy in your sales process.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up your digital store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage the backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments to enable Bitcoin transactions and facilitate automated delivery of your products. Test your setup thoroughly to ensure a smooth customer experience. Launch your store and promote your digital products to reach your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept Bitcoin payments for my digital products?
You can accept Bitcoin payments by integrating NOWPayments into your online store. This service allows for seamless cryptocurrency transactions with low fees and automatic payment verification.
What are the advantages of using Bitcoin for selling digital downloads?

Using Bitcoin reduces transaction fees compared to traditional platforms, enhances privacy, and allows for immediate payment confirmation. This ensures you keep more of your profits and have full control over your sales process.
What do I need to set up my own digital store?

You will need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, a backend management system such as Google Apps Script, and a payment processor like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. These components work together to create a fully functional online store.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products with this setup?
Yes, this infrastructure supports various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. You can customize your offerings based on your audience's needs.
What are the costs involved in setting up this system?
The primary costs include the purchase of NOWPayments services at a low fee of 0.5% per transaction. Additional costs may arise from hosting services, but many options are free or low-cost.
Operate independently of traditional platforms that impose restrictions.
